entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Exams are coming up soon.[n]Have you been studying?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We could study together.[n]I can teach you the parts[n]you don't understand.
entries.uk: Можемо повчитися разом.[n]Я поясню те, чого ти[n]не розумієш.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'll be in front of the[n]student council room, so[n]feel free to call out to me.
entries.uk: Я буду біля кімнати[n]учнівської ради, тож[n]звертайся.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'll be in front of the[n]school entrance, so feel[n]free to call out to me.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So, what's it going to be? Do you want[n]to go see Makoto?
